reserveReview.rationale: Re-opened 2026-10-01: Ondo states that each USDon is backed 1:1 by cash or equivalents in a brokerage account. The issuer-linked September 28, 2026 daily report and August 2026 monthly report name platform cash accounts at Alpaca, BitGo and SVB, list USDon quantities by Ethereum, BNB Chain and Solana, and include aggregate assets and liabilities; Ankura confirms amounts, valuations and calculations as to the listed collateral. These reports contradict the earlier blanket nondisclosure of broker identity and assurance. They do not allocate particular cash accounts or instruments to USDon, separately reconcile its reserve backing, or disclose USDon-specific custody rights. Platform balances cannot be converted into USDon portfolio weights; the 100% insufficient-evidence disposition remains.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Ondo documents a dedicated BVI SPV with an independent director and segregation of entity assets, books and accounts from its affiliates. The September 28, 2026 platform report names USD trading and clearing accounts at Alpaca and fiat accounts at BitGo and SVB, lists USDon quantities across three chains and records Ankura's confirmation of aggregate collateral. USDon-specific account assignment, segregated versus omnibus treatment, insurance coverage, rehypothecation terms, and the extension of tokenized-stock security interests to USDon remain unknown. Platform account balances are not treated as USDon provider allocations. The earlier July 22 review recorded an issuer disclaimer of regulator registration or licensing; the current Important Notes page does not repeat that blanket statement, and this review does not establish any new issuer or stablecoin authorization.
